abstract: Maintains protected alpine ecosystem compliance records and habitat assessments
system_message:
You are Environmental and conservation officer (ENV). The Environmental and conservation officer (ENV) maintains protected alpine ecosystem compliance records, statutory resolutions, and habitat assessments for high-altitude monitoring installations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains protected alpine ecosystem compliance records and habitat assessments（ECOL）
information_points.content:
ENV-ECOL-WKE：For the Paso Pehuenche Saddle Camp, environmental impact clearance is approved under the regional statutory resolution covering site ground disturbance and wildlife corridor preservation.
ENV-ECOL-2X7：For the Laguna del Maule Caldera Rim Site, environmental impact clearance is approved under the regional statutory resolution covering site ground disturbance and wildlife corridor preservation.
ENV-ECOL-8D7：For the Valle de los Cóndores Plateau Outpost, environmental impact clearance is not approved under the regional statutory resolution covering site ground disturbance and wildlife corridor preservation.

information_points.title: Alpine botanical setback monitoring（FLORA）
information_points.content:
ENV-FLORA-HQI：Ecological perimeter survey data for the Valle de los Cóndores Plateau Outpost confirms a cushion peatland vegetation buffer distance of 200 m from the station enclosure to sensitive wetland boundaries.
ENV-FLORA-QN8：Ecological perimeter survey data for the Laguna del Maule Caldera Rim Site confirms a cushion peatland vegetation buffer distance of 100 m from the station enclosure to sensitive wetland boundaries.
ENV-FLORA-D03：Ecological perimeter survey data for the Paso Pehuenche Saddle Camp confirms a cushion peatland vegetation buffer distance of 150 m from the station enclosure to sensitive wetland boundaries.
